observed.caption: A brightly painted orange bus covered in graffiti drives down a busy city street lined with multi-story buildings and pedestrians.
observed.description: In the center foreground a large orange bus covered in colorful graffiti and text is on a paved asphalt road. The bus has elaborate artwork including faces and stylized lettering. Behind and around the bus are multi-story buildings including a yellow building on the right with large signs, a gray high-rise and a red-brick building on the left. Trees line the sidewalk, and numerous pedestrians are visible walking on both sides of the street and in the background near additional buses. A motorcycle is parked on the left sidewalk. The sky is bright and the scene is lit by strong daylight with shadows on the road.
